description: This file contains utility functions for parsing date/time strings, computing date offsets, and handling custom time ranges within the superset-ui-core package, specifically related to time comparison and offset calculations.

methods.name: parseDttmToDate
methods.description: Parses a date/time string into a Date object, handling relative times like 'Last week', 'ago', and specific date formats.

methods.name: computeCustomDateTime
methods.description: Computes a Date object by adding or subtracting a specified amount of time units (seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, quarters, years) to/from a given date string.

methods.name: getTimeOffset
methods.description: Calculates an array of time offset strings based on a time range filter, shifts, start date, and optional future offset inclusion, considering custom and inherited ranges.
